description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to executing code via an XAI (Explainable AI) system, including configuration resolution, payload building, and making requests to the code execution endpoint.

methods.name: resolveXaiCodeExecutionConfig
methods.description: Resolves and coerces a configuration object into an XaiCodeExecutionConfig type.

methods.name: resolveXaiCodeExecutionModel
methods.description: Resolves the model to use for code execution, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: resolveXaiCodeExecutionMaxTurns
methods.description: Resolves the maximum number of turns for code execution from the config.

methods.name: buildXaiCodeExecutionPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload object for a code execution request.

methods.name: requestXaiCodeExecution
methods.description: Sends a request to execute code via the XAI system and processes the response.
